### Multicollinearity: Detection and Reduction techniques in regression models.

This folder contains markdown and python source code illustrating cases of multicollinearity, effects of multicollinearity on regression models' output as well as its effects on the weights of independent variables.

- This project is built upon this blog post:
[Multicollinearity-in-regression-analysis](https://statisticsbyjim.com/regression/multicollinearity-in-regression-analysis/)

# Developing concepts
* Endogeniety.
* relationship between p-values and R-Squared statistic
* P-value's significance.
* Effects of differencing on p-values.
* PCA(Dimensionality Reduction technique)
* How Skleran's OLS differs from Statsmodels'
* Fixed effects versus random effects formulas.
* What are GLMS and how they compare to GLMS
* VIF(Variance Inflation Factor)
* Effects of differencing on VIF.
* How to reduce multicollinearity(PCA, feature removal,feature combination/conversion)
* Will removal of dimensionality kill the 'rank deficiency warning'
* What is kernel approximation


### Endogeniety
- Refers to a situation in econometrics where an explanatory variable is correlated with the error term in a regression model.

  ## Causes
  1. Two way causality
  2. Omitted variables
